record.title: CELL2 R88 TCPS fanout learning
record.body: Downstream pull selected only admitted root-GGEN consumers not already realized by R87. Shared R86 was reused for chatman-ecosystem and unrdf. unrdf checkout failed before semantic execution because open-ontologies has no URL in .gitmodules; the Andon was preserved and transport was changed to exact-SHA archive materialization, after which the exact R88/R86 court passed. cargo-cicd was not mutated because its local doctrine requires agent mutation through cargo cicd *. Cognitive WIP is zero for these three: two became executable qualified consumers; one became a typed authority stop with an explicit lawful-next-executor requirement.

upstream_returns: candidate: exact-SHA archive materialization for consumers whose git metadata prevents actions/checkout
candidate: executor-selection contract must honor consumer repository mutation law before allocating write transport
